entities.name: Mirian III of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mirian III was a king (mepe) of Iberia or Kartli (Georgia), contemporaneous to the Roman emperor Constantine the Great. He was the founder of the royal Chosroid dynasty.
